name: The Futile Travail
descriptionTemplate:
Hand Limit +1. At battle start, generate 1 "{Gauntward}" and place it in hand.
When any Awakener's "Basic Strike" is played, "{Gauntward}" Arithmetica Cost -1, inflict [Arg1] {Corrosion} on all enemies.
When any Awakener's "Basic Defense" is played, gain [Arg2] {STR}, and the Final DMG and {STR} generation of "{Gauntward}" +[Arg3]% next time it is played.
lore: The futile man fears change, fears things slipping beyond his grasp; and in the deepest part of him, he fears loss with a frantic, hysterical dread. He blows the whistle again and again, hoping its sound will let him control everything, yet he can hold on to nothing.
